scientific_roles.frozen_six_species: immutable completed development result and calibration benchmark
scientific_roles.frozen_34_species: literature-classification method and supplementary comparative analysis; never the atlas admission frame

metadata_source.provider: iNaturalist v1 metadata for pilot; monthly iNaturalist Open Data metadata for later bulk scale-out

admission.basis: flowering-annotated iNaturalist metadata abundance followed by deterministic geometry and balance gates
admission.failed_species_rule: retain the failure in the audit and continue through the predeclared metadata ranking; never inspect images or colour to replace it
admission.shortfall_rule: STOP and version a prospective metadata-only amendment; do not relax gates after image pixels are opened

geometry_only_scale_selection.nonpassing_species_rule: retain as not_evaluable at that scale; never replace after colour inspection
geometry_only_scale_selection.sensitivity_rule: report all 100, 250 and 500 km candidates; the first passing scale is primary and cannot be replaced by a stronger colour result

ordered_pipeline: automated flower ROI with explicit not_evaluable state

season_phenology_sensitivity.primary: all admitted dates with species-conditioned permutation
season_phenology_sensitivity.sensitivity_1: permute within species and observed calendar month where strata are sufficient
season_phenology_sensitivity.sensitivity_2: permute within species and hemisphere-adjusted local-solar quarter
season_phenology_sensitivity.sparse_stratum_rule: merge only by the predeclared adjacent cyclic rule or retain the species-scale result as not_evaluable; never optimize on colour
season_phenology_sensitivity.claim_ceiling: seasonal sensitivity can diagnose photographic phenology confounding but cannot establish a phenological mechanism

products: species-free global map coloured by continuous flower ROI colour
species-free photo bar of automated flower ROI thumbnails

claim_ceiling.metadata_gate: sampling feasibility only; no colour or spatial biological result
claim_ceiling.geometry_gate: detectability and scale support only; no shared boundary result
claim_ceiling.future_primary: species-conditioned cross-species concentration of continuous flower-colour transitions
forbidden: universal biological boundary from a display
mechanism or adaptation from photographic association
repair of failed gates by post-colour retuning
